release_notes: Updated Anime Revival Extractor to v1.0.11: fixed multi-season/TV show parsing, added OK.ru/Drive/Hydrax & retired Archive.org fallback, and prioritized highest-resolution Blogger & Abyss streams
Fixed KReanime Extractor v1.0.1: fixed FlixCloud WASM branch execution crash and missing opcode handling
Updated KAnikoto Extractor to v1.0.2 and KAnimeHeaven Extractor to v1.0.2 to prefer highest-resolution video sources

plugins.name: KAnikoto Extractor
plugins.author: KAnime Official
plugins.description: Official online streaming plugin for Anikoto with MegaPlay AES decryption and multi-server HLS streams.
changelog: Prioritized highest-resolution streams across Vidstream, MegaPlay, and MegaCloud extraction
Ordered multi-server choices by expected stream quality priority

plugins.name: KReanime Extractor
plugins.author: KAnime Official
plugins.description: High-speed anime streaming plugin for ReAnime with rotating WASM-based FlixCloud AES-256 decryption and multi-server HLS streams.
changelog: Fixed FlixCloud WASM VM branch (br / br_if) execution crash and missing i32 opcode support
Added Base64 fallback handling across key derivation and local manifest proxy playback

plugins.name: KAnimeHeaven Extractor
plugins.author: KAnime Official
plugins.description: Direct high-speed MP4 anime streaming plugin for AnimeHeaven with session-aware gate extraction.
changelog: Ranked multi-source video elements to prefer soft-subbed MP4s and the highest available resolution

plugins.name: KOpenSubtitle
plugins.author: KAnime Official
plugins.description: Precision online subtitle provider using OpenSubtitles with exact MAL/AniList ID & episode matching.
changelog: Added exact MAL/AniList/Kitsu -> IMDb + season mapping via ARM
Added air-date, episode-title, split-cour Part 2, and absolute episode matching
Prioritized Crunchyroll/SubsPlease/Erai/WEB-DL releases over Netflix/BluRay cuts with release labels

plugins.name: Anime Revival Extractor
plugins.author: Anime Revival
plugins.description: Tagalog-dubbed anime streaming plugin for Anime Revival supporting series, multi-season shows, and multi-host MP4 playback through a built-in local stream proxy.
changelog: Fixed series & TV-show metadata, search aliases, season selection, and outlier/duplicate episode handling
Added OK.ru, Google Drive, PlayHydrax, p.php wrapper unwrapping, and retired Archive.org mirror fallback
Prioritized 1080p Blogger streams (itag=37 > itag=22) and highest-resolution Abyss streams through the local proxy
